about: Backgrounds and professions as Deem tables. Orsino's backgroundModifier (data/catalog/orsino/backgrounds.json, generated) gives each one its scores, gold, class and gear; these tables say what it means in a Kyr world. backgroundKind puts every Orsino background in one kind; backgroundKindMeaning gives a kind's skills, gear, the question its trades are asked by at creation (asks), what a life of it is in a sentence (life), and the channel an old acquaintance hears news through (the n-th background of a kind takes the kind's n-th contact line, round again); backgroundOverlay changes one background where it differs from its kind. Compiled into the catalog by BackgroundCatalog.

wild.name: Wild country
wild.asks: What did you do in the backcountry?
wild.life: A life lived off the land: hunting, tracking, herding and keeping the woods.
contacts: {contact} and {member} hunted the same hills for a season.
{contact} and {member} once sat out three days of snow in the same bothy.
{contact} buys skins from {member} and pays fair for them.

roads.name: The roads
roads.asks: What did you do on the roads?
roads.life: A life on the move: carrying goods, word and maps from one town to the next.
contacts: {contact} walked a surveyor's road with {member} years ago.
{contact} drove the same caravan road as {member}.
{contact} and {member} shared a waystation fire through a whole wet autumn.

mechanisms.name: Locks and mechanisms
mechanisms.asks: What did you make at the bench?
mechanisms.life: A life of fine work: locks, clocks, bells and things that move.
contacts: {contact} once bought {member}'s work and asked no questions about it.
{contact} still has a lock {member} made, and shows it to people.

shadows.name: The shadows
shadows.asks: What did you do in the shadows?
shadows.life: A life outside the law: theft, smuggling, cards and worse.
contacts: {contact} has bought things from {member} before and never asked where they came from.
{contact} owes {member} a favour from a night neither of them talks about.

healing.name: Healing
healing.asks: How did you tend the sick?
healing.life: A life of tending: setting bones, mixing simples, nursing the sick.
contacts: {contact} and {member} nursed the sick together through a hard winter.
{contact} learned to set a bone from watching {member} do it.

faith.name: The faith
faith.asks: What were you in the faith?
faith.life: A life given to a god: rites, shrines, alms and the hunt for what is unholy.
contacts: {contact} and {member} kept the same altar as novices.
{contact} fed {member} at a shrine door through a hard winter.

learning.name: Learning
learning.life: A life of study: books, stars, old tongues and the arts.
contacts: {contact} once lent {member} a book they never asked to have back.
{contact} keeps a library {member} was once allowed to use.

earth.name: Stone and earth
earth.asks: What did you do with stone and earth?
earth.life: A life of digging and building: mines, quarries, walls and gardens.
contacts: {contact} worked the same seam as {member} before taking the inn.
{contact} sold {member} a map of a barrow that turned out to be real.

arms.name: Arms
arms.asks: What did you do under arms?
arms.life: A life of fighting, or of making what fighters carry.
contacts: {contact} served in the same company as {member}.
{contact} once carried {member} off a field, and has never let them forget it.

water.name: The water
water.asks: What did you do on the water?
water.life: A life on boats: rivers, nets, ships and the open sea.
contacts: {contact} and {member} worked the same barges, years back.
{contact} once pulled {member} out of a river in spate.

stage.name: The stage
stage.asks: What did you do on the stage?
stage.life: A life before a crowd: songs, tales, plays and tricks.
contacts: {contact} has heard {member} sing and still pours them a cup for it.
{contact} once hired {member} for a week and paid for two.

trade.name: A trade
trade.life: A life of honest work: baking, brewing, weaving, farming, selling.
contacts: {contact} buys {member}'s work and pays on the nail.
{contact} and {member} kept stalls side by side for a season.

court.name: Courts and offices
court.asks: What was your place at court?
court.life: A life in office: courts, councils, taxes and the high-born.
contacts: {contact} once supplied {member}'s household and remembers the name.
{contact} stood in a long queue behind {member} at the assizes and heard everything.

margins.name: The margins
margins.asks: How did you live on the margins?
margins.life: A life at the edge: cast out, locked up, or barely living through it.
contacts: {contact} hid {member} once, when it mattered, and never said a word.
{contact} knew {member} when neither of them had a name worth giving.

tracker.contact: {contact} and {member} once trailed a stolen flock across three valleys.

forester.contact: {contact} and {member} cut timber in the same holt one summer.

caravaner.contact: {contact} drove the same caravan road as {member}.

outlaw.contact: {contact} hid {member} from the reeve one winter and never said a word.

apothecary.contact: {contact} trades in the same simples {member} does.

smith.contact: {contact} buys {member}'s ironwork and pays on the nail.

archaeologist.contact: {contact} sold {member} a map of a barrow that turned out to be real.

mendicant.contact: {contact} fed {member} at a shrine door through a hard winter.
